name: Stavsnäs, Nämdö, Bullerö and Långviksskär
description: Outer-archipelago route from Stavsnäs through Nämdö waters to Bullerö and Långviksskär, overlapping the new Nämdöskärgården National Park context.

waypoints.name: Bullerön
waypoints.notes: National park entry and service node.

publicTransport: Transfer, bus or car to Stavsnäs
ferry: Seasonal passenger boats from Stavsnäs to Bullerö/Rågskär/Braka/Hamnskär; otherwise private boat or boat taxi.
launchNotes: Get Out Kayak / The Kayak Trail packages use Stavsnäs.

safety.exposure: Outer archipelago; weather and wind govern conditions. Långviksskär is exposed.
windWeatherNotes: Only for stable forecasts with rescue competence.
navigationNotes: Need charts and current national-park no-navigation/no-landing polygons.
seasonalNotes: National park bird/camping/vessel restrictions apply; some restrictions start with 2026 season.

campingRules: Nämdöskärgården National Park: camping up to 2 nights in most places; Bullerö designated campsite up to 7 nights; no camping/hammocks in some areas; no landing in bird-protection areas; fires only at designated sites or raised grills. Verify current rules.

protectionRules.summary: Bullerö/Nämdöskärgården has transitioned from reserve rules to national-park rules; paddlers must verify current landing/camping limits before entering outer-island areas.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Use designated visitor infrastructure where available.
Expect restrictions on landing/camping in sensitive places.
Verify current national-park regulations before import/use.

needsFollowup: Verify exact current protection boundaries against Naturvårdsverket Skyddad natur map before public navigation/import.
